rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠１８９＿００４Really? ...I'm so happy!＝＠１８９＿００５Going to Elan with you was what￥I was aiming for, but...＝＠１８９＿００６I wasn't the one who got to￥choose, so I'd almost given up.
＊Yoh＊＠１８９＿００７Thank you! Let's give it our￥all, together!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Yoh Depart　－

＊Yoh＊＠１８９＿０１８Ahh, we're really going to Elan.￥It's kind of moving...＝＠１８９＿０１９All that tough training￥was for this day,￥wasn't it...＝＠１８９＿０２０I'd almost given up on ever￥qualifying... It's all￥thanks to you.
＊Yoh＊＠１９０＿００１For me, meeting you...＝＠１９０＿００２was an even bigger deal than￥going off to explore Elan...＝＠１９０＿００３Thanks for choosing me.
＊Yoh＊＠１９０＿００４For me, even more than￥exploring Elan...＝＠１９０＿００５getting to go there with you is￥what really makes me happy.＝＠１９０＿００６I'm so glad I have you...￥Thanks for choosing me.
